string.name: name
string.value: Return Scroll

string.name: desc
string.value: If you use a scroll after #cdragging & dropping# the Return Scroll, depending on your choice, you can restore #call of the item options to their pre-scroll values, excluding Potentials#. \nWhen you use Return Scroll, you can only return item options that were changed by the #cscroll which deducted the number of available upgrades#. The Return Scroll effect disappears upon use, regardless of the result. The scroll is restricted to use on #csupplied Tutorial Equipment Items# and some other items. Cannot be used along with #cShield Scroll#.
